name: Zeta23.DigammaSeries.digamma_series
statement:
theorem digamma_series {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Complex.integerComplement) :
    Complex.digamma z = -(Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) - 1 / z
      + ∑' n : ℕ, (1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1) - 1 / (z + n + 1))

name: Zeta23.DigammaSeries.harmonic_cast_eq
statement:
lemma harmonic_cast_eq (N : ℕ) :
    ((harmonic N : ℚ) : ℝ) = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1)

name: Zeta23.DigammaSeries.hasSum_digamma_series
statement:
theorem hasSum_digamma_series {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Complex.integerComplement) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1) - 1 / (z + n + 1))
      (Complex.digamma z + (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) + 1 / z)

name: Zeta23.DigammaSeries.inv_gammaSeq_eq
statement:
lemma inv_gammaSeq_eq {z : ℂ} (_hz : z ∈ Complex.integerComplement) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (Complex.GammaSeq z N)⁻¹
      = z * Complex.exp ((((∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1))
            - Real.log N : ℝ) : ℂ) * z)
          * ∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + wTerm n z)

name: Zeta23.DigammaSeries.inv_gamma_eq_prod
statement:
theorem inv_gamma_eq_prod {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Complex.integerComplement) :
    (Complex.Gamma z)⁻¹
      = z * Complex.exp ((Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) * z)
          * ∏' n : ℕ, (1 + wTerm n z)

name: Zeta23.DigammaSeries.logDeriv_one_add_wTerm
statement:
lemma logDeriv_one_add_wTerm {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Complex.integerComplement) (n : ℕ) :

name: Zeta23.DigammaSeries.one_add_wTerm

RHLinalg.rank_trace_ineq
statement:
theorem rank_trace_ineq {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hP : P.PosSemidef) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian)
    {r b : ℕ} (hr : P.rank ≤ r) (hb : posIndex hQ ≤ b)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    c * rtrace P - c ^ 2 / 4 * r + 2 * c * rtrace Q - c ^ 2 * b
      ≤ frobSq (P + Q)

name: RHLinalg.rank_trace_ineq_two
statement:
theorem rank_trace_ineq_two {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜}

    {r b : ℕ} (hr : P.rank ≤ r) (hb : posIndex hQ ≤ b) :
    2 * rtrace P + 4 * rtrace Q - 4 * (b : ℝ) - frobSq (P + Q) ≤ (r : ℝ)

    {N0star N NII trGh frGh B lam₁ R₁ R₂ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h0 : 4 * trGh - frGh - 2 * N - 3 * NII - B * (4 + 2 * Real.sqrt frGh + B) ≤ N0star)
    (htr : |trGh - N| ≤ R₁) (hfr : frGh ≤ (1 / lam₁ + lam₁ / 3) * N + R₂) :
    Hfun lam₁ * N - (4 * R₁ + R₂ + 3 * NII
        + B * (4 + 2 * Real.sqrt ((1 / lam₁ + lam₁ / 3) * N + R₂) + B)) ≤ N0star

theorem N0star_lower_explicit
    {N0star s12 : ℕ} {N NII trGh frGh trAh frAh B : ℝ}

    (hK : 0 ≤ 1 + C * calE)

              ≤ C * calE * (T * L / (2 * Real.pi) * (ℓ₁ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 / 3)))
    (hRvM : T * ℓ₁ / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ N + RN) :

      ≤ (1 / (L / ℓ₁) + (L / ℓ₁) / 3) * N
        + (1 / (L / ℓ₁) + (L / ℓ₁) / 3) * (((1 + C * calE) / a ^ 2 - 1) * N

statement:
theorem seamA (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hB : BlockInputs Z P T) {θ₀ : ℝ} (hTl : TailInputs Z P T θ₀)
    (ha : 0 < P.a T) (hL : 0 < P.L T) :
    4 * rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) - frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) - 2 * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)
      - 3 * (NII Z T : ℝ)
      - θ₀ / (P.a T * P.L T) * (4 + 2 * Real.sqrt (frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T))) + θ₀ / (P.a T * P.L T))
      ≤ Z.N0star T (2 * T)

    2 * (posIndexAbove hGt θ : ℝ) - (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - 2 * (NII Z T : ℝ) ≤ Z.N0s T (2 * T) ∧
      (posIndexAbove hGt θ : ℝ) - (NII Z T : ℝ) ≤ Z.Nd T (2 * T)

name: Zeta23.Assembly.seamB
statement:
theorem seamB (hGzGp : Z.Gz P T = P.Gp T) (ha : 0 < P.a T) (hL : 0 < P.L T) (hℓ₁ : 0 < ell1 T)
    {C₁ C₂ ET RN : ℝ}
    (htr1 : |P.trGtilde T - P.a T * P.L T * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)| ≤ C₁ * (P.L T * Real.sqrt (P.X T)))
    (hK : 0 ≤ 1 + C₂ * ET)
    (htr2 : P.trGtildeSq T - P.mainTr2 T ≤ C₂ * ET * P.mainTr2 T)
    (hRvM : T * ell1 T / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) + RN) :
    |rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) - (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)| ≤ C₁ * Real.sqrt (P.X T) / P.a T ∧
    frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) ≤ (1 / P.lam1 T + P.lam1 T / 3) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)
      + (1 / P.lam1 T + P.lam1 T / 3) * (((1 + C₂ * ET) / P.a T ^ 2 - 1) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)
          + (1 + C₂ * ET) / P.a T ^ 2 * RN)

name: Zeta23.Assembly.thmA_abstract_err
statement:
theorem thmA_abstract_err (Z : ZeroConfig) (hRvM : RiemannVonMangoldt Z) (P : Params) (hP : P.Valid)
    (hlam : P.lam < 1) (Err : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hTr : TracesBoundsE P Err P.a P.trGtilde P.trGtildeSq (fun T => (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)))
    (hBlock : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, BlockInputs Z P T)
    (θ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) (hTail : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, TailInputs Z P T (θ₀ T))
    (hθ₀ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, θ₀ T ≤ C * l T * T ^ (P.lam / 2 - 1))
    (hNII : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, (NII Z T : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.sqrt T * l T)
    (hGzGp : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, Z.Gz P T = P.Gp T)
    (ha : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 1 - 2 * P.w / P.L T ≤ P.a T ∧ P.a T ≤ 1)
    (hcalE : Tendsto Err atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀, (Hfun P.lam - ε) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ Z.N0star T (2 * T)

theorem thmBC_core (Z : ZeroConfig) (H : PaperInputs Z) (P : Params) (hP : P.Valid)
    (hlam : P.lam < 1) (hTr : ThmTracesHyp P Z)
    (hBlock : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, BlockInputs Z P T)
    (θ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) (hTail : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, TailInputs Z P T (θ₀ T))
    (hθ₀ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, θ₀ T ≤ C * l T * T ^ (P.lam / 2 - 1))
    (hNII : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, (NII Z T : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.sqrt T * l T)
    (hGzGp : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, Z.Gz P T = P.Gp T)
    (hcalE : Tendsto P.calE atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ, R =o[atTop] (fun T => (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
        (2 * Ffun P.lam - 1) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - 2 * R T ≤ Z.N0s T (2 * T) ∧
        Ffun P.lam * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - R T ≤ Z.Nd T (2 * T)

name: Zeta23.Assembly.zeroside_core
statement:
theorem zeroside_core {At Et : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hAt : At.IsHermitian) (hEt : Et.IsHermitian)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ∀ i, |hEt.eigenvalues i| ≤ θ)
    {s₁ s₂ p cardZ : ℕ} (hblock_pos : posIndex hAt ≤ s₁ + s₂ + p) (hblock_rank : At.rank ≤ cardZ)
    {NI' : ℝ} (hNcount : (s₁ : ℝ) + 2 * s₂ + 2 * p ≤ NI') :
    2 * (posIndexAbove (hAt.add hEt) θ : ℝ) - NI' ≤ s₁ ∧
      posIndexAbove (hAt.add hEt) θ ≤ cardZ

    {Non NI' : ℝ} (htrP : rtrace P ≤ Non) (hNcount : Non + 2 * b ≤ NI') :
    4 * rtrace Ahat - 2 * NI' - frobSq Ahat ≤ r

name: Zeta23.Assembly.N0star_lower_moment
statement:

    {N0star N NII trGh frGh B κ R₁ R₂ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h0 : 4 * trGh - frGh - 2 * N - 3 * NII - B * (4 + 2 * Real.sqrt frGh + B) ≤ N0star)
    (htr : N - R₁ ≤ trGh) (hfr : frGh ≤ κ * N + R₂) :
    (2 - κ) * N - (4 * R₁ + R₂ + 3 * NII
        + B * (4 + 2 * Real.sqrt (κ * N + R₂) + B)) ≤ N0star

name: Zeta23.Assembly.count_certificate
statement:
theorem count_certificate (Z : ZeroConfig) (P : Params) (κ : ℝ) (lower : ℝ → ℝ)
    (θ₀ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 4 * rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) - frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T))
      - 2 * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - 3 * (NII Z T : ℝ)
      - θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T)
          * (4 + 2 * Real.sqrt (frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T))) + θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T))
      ≤ lower T)
    (hB0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 0 ≤ θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T))
    (hBto : Tendsto (fun T => θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hNII_o : (fun T => (NII Z T : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun T => (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)))
    (hNtop : Tendsto (fun T => (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)) atTop atTop)
    (htrace : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
      (1 - δ) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)))
    (hfrob : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
      frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) ≤ (κ + δ) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀, (2 - κ - ε) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ lower T

name: Zeta23.Assembly.count_lower_moment_c3
statement:
theorem count_lower_moment_c3
    {lower N NII trGh frGh B κ R₁ R₂ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h0 : 6 * trGh - frGh - 3 * N - 5 * NII - B * (6 + 2 * Real.sqrt frGh + B) ≤ 2 * lower)
    (htr : N - R₁ ≤ trGh) (hfr : frGh ≤ κ * N + R₂) :
    (3/2 - κ/2) * N - (3 * R₁ + R₂ / 2 + (5/2) * NII
        + (B/2) * (6 + 2 * Real.sqrt (κ * N + R₂) + B)) ≤ lower

name: Zeta23.Assembly.count_certificate_c3
statement:
theorem count_certificate_c3 (Z : ZeroConfig) (P : Params) (κ : ℝ) (lower : ℝ → ℝ)
    (θ₀ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 6 * rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) - frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T))
      - 3 * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - 5 * (NII Z T : ℝ)
      - θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T)
          * (6 + 2 * Real.sqrt (frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T))) + θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T))
      ≤ 2 * lower T)
    (hB0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 0 ≤ θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T))
    (hBto : Tendsto (fun T => θ₀ T / (P.a T * P.L T)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hNII_o : (fun T => (NII Z T : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun T => (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)))
    (hNtop : Tendsto (fun T => (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)) atTop atTop)
    (htrace : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
      (1 - δ) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)))
    (hfrob : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
      frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) ≤ (κ + δ) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀, (3/2 - κ/2 - ε) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ lower T

    (habs : ∀ r, ψ |r| = ψ r) (hnn : ∀ r, 0 ≤ ψ r) (hleL : ∀ r, ψ r ≤ L)
    (hdecay : ∀ r, r ≠ 0 → ψ r ≤ c / (w * r ^ 2)) (hint : Integrable (fun r => ψ r ^ 2)) :
    Integrable (fun r => ψ r ^ 2 * (2 + |r|) ^ 2) ∧
    ∫ r, ψ r ^ 2 * (2 + |r|) ^ 2 ≤ 18 * L ^ 2 + 18 * (c / w) ^ 2

    (hfs : tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2)) (hgs : tsupport g ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2))

    Integrable (fun τ : ℝ => paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ)) ∧

name: BlaschkeOfZero
statement:
lemma BlaschkeOfZero {r R : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ}

name: LogOfAnalyticFunction
statement:
theorem LogOfAnalyticFunction {r R : ℝ} {B : ℂ → ℂ}
    (zero_lt_r : 0 < r) (r_lt_R : r < R)
    (BanalyticOnNhdOfDR : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ B (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R))
    (Bnonzero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R, B z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (J_B : ℂ → ℂ), (AnalyticOnNhd ℂ J_B (Metric.ball 0 R)) ∧
      (J_B 0 = 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r, (deriv J_B) z = (deriv B) z / (B z)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball 0 R, Real.log ‖B z‖ - Real.log ‖B 0‖ = (J_B z).re)

name: LogOfAnalyticFunction'
statement:
theorem LogOfAnalyticFunction' {r' r R : ℝ} {B : ℂ → ℂ}
    (r'_pos : 0 < r') (r'_lt_r : r' < r) (r_lt_R : r < R)
    (BanalyticOnNhdOfDR : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ B (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R))
    (Bnonzero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r, B z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (J_B : ℂ → ℂ), (AnalyticOnNhd ℂ J_B (Metric.ball 0 r)) ∧
      (J_B 0 = 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r', (deriv J_B) z = (deriv B) z / (B z)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball 0 r, Real.log ‖B z‖ - Real.log ‖B 0‖ = (J_B z).re)

name: ZeroFactorization
statement:
lemma ZeroFactorization {R : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (RleOne : R < 1)
    (hfAnalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1))
    (hf_neq_zero_at_zero : f 0 ≠ 0)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ SetOfZeros R f) :
    ∃ h_ρ : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h_ρ ρ ∧ h_ρ ρ ≠ 0 ∧ ZeroFactor f ρ = h_ρ ρ ∧
      f =ᶠ[nhds ρ] fun z ↦ (z - ρ) ^ analyticOrderNatAt f ρ * h_ρ z

name: ZerosBound
statement:
theorem ZerosBound {B r R : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (r_pos : 0 < r) (r_lt_one : r < 1) (r_lt_R : r < R) (R_lt_one : R < 1)
    (hfAnalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1)) (hf0_eq_one : f 0 = 1)
    (finiteZeros : (SetOfZeros 1 f).Finite) (fz_bound : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ R → ‖f z‖ ≤ B) :
    ∑ ρ ∈ (finiteSetOfZeros_mono r_lt_one finiteZeros).toFinset, analyticOrderNatAt f ρ ≤
      1 / Real.log (R / r) * Real.log B

        * (Complex.digamma ((((1 : ℝ) / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + Complex.I * ((τ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))).re

name: Zeta23.MuFields.re_digamma_vertical
statement:
theorem re_digamma_vertical (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (Complex.digamma ((a : ℂ) + Complex.I * t)).re
      = -Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - a / (a ^ 2 + t ^ 2)
        + ∑' n : ℕ,
          (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - ((n : ℝ) + 1 + a) / (((n : ℝ) + 1 + a) ^ 2 + t ^ 2))

name: Zeta23.MuInts.int_mu_of_stirling
statement:
theorem int_mu_of_stirling (hst : StirlingHyp) :

      |(∫ τ in T..(2 * T), Zeta23.mu τ) - T * ell1 T / (2 * Real.pi)| ≤ C / T

      |(∫ τ in T..(2 * T), Zeta23.mu τ ^ 2) - T * ell1 T ^ 2 / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)|
        ≤ C * (T * ell1 T ^ 2 / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)) / l T ^ 2

      = T * (ell1 T ^ 2 + 1 - 2 * Real.log 2 ^ 2)

name: Zeta23.StirlingVert.digamma_eq
statement:
theorem digamma_eq (hw : 0 < w.re) (ht : 1 / 2 ≤ |w.im|) :
    Complex.digamma w = Complex.log (1 + w) - 1 / w - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (1 + w)⁻¹
      - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (∑' n, rho w n) + ∑' n : ℕ, eps w ((n : ℝ) + 1)

    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Complex.log ((y : ℂ) + w)) (((x : ℂ) + w)⁻¹) x

name: Zeta23.StirlingVert.integral_inv_add_eq
statement:
theorem integral_inv_add_eq {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.re) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) :
    ∫ x in m..(m + 1), ((x : ℂ) + w)⁻¹
      = ((m : ℂ) + w)⁻¹ - (1 / 2 : ℂ) / ((m : ℂ) + w) ^ 2 + eps w m

name: Zeta23.StirlingVert.integral_inv_add_eq_log_sub

theorem integral_inv_add_eq_log_sub {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.re) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) :
    ∫ x in m..(m + 1), ((x : ℂ) + w)⁻¹
      = Complex.log (((m + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + w) - Complex.log ((m : ℂ) + w)

name: Zeta23.StirlingVert.intervalIntegral_mul_const_C
statement:
theorem intervalIntegral_mul_const_C (c : ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) :

name: Zeta23.StirlingVert.inv_add_expand
statement:
theorem inv_add_expand {w : ℂ} {x m : ℝ} (hxw : (x : ℂ) + w ≠ 0) (hmw : (m : ℂ) + w ≠ 0) :
    ((x : ℂ) + w)⁻¹
      = ((m : ℂ) + w)⁻¹ - ((x - m : ℝ) : ℂ) / ((m : ℂ) + w) ^ 2
        + ((x - m : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 / (((m : ℂ) + w) ^ 2 * ((x : ℂ) + w))

name: Zeta23.StirlingVert.inv_natp1_eq
statement:
theorem inv_natp1_eq (hw : 0 < w.re) (n : ℕ) :
    ((n : ℂ) + 1 + w)⁻¹
      = (Complex.log (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 + w) - Complex.log ((n : ℂ) + 1 + w))
        + (1 / 2 : ℂ) / ((n : ℂ) + 1 + w) ^ 2 - eps w ((n : ℝ) + 1)

name: Zeta23.StirlingVert.inv_natp1_sq_eq
statement:
theorem inv_natp1_sq_eq (hw : 0 < w.re) (n : ℕ) :
    1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1 + w) ^ 2
      = (((n : ℂ) + 1 + w)⁻¹ - (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 + w)⁻¹) + rho w n

        - (Complex.log ((N : ℂ) + 1 + w) - Complex.log ((0 : ℕ) + 1 + w : ℂ))
        - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (((0 : ℕ) + 1 + w : ℂ)⁻¹ - ((N : ℂ) + 1 + w)⁻¹
            + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, rho w n)

name: Zeta23.MV.eigen_identity'
statement:
theorem eigen_identity' (hinj : Function.Injective freq) (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ r, 0 < c r)
    (u : ι → ℂ) (μ : ℝ)
    (heig : ∀ m, ∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.erase m,
        ((c m * c n / (freq m - freq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) * u n = (μ : ℂ) * Complex.I * u m)
    (m : ι) :
    μ ^ 2 * ‖u m‖ ^ 2 =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, (c m * c n) ^ 2 * ‖u n‖ ^ 2 / (freq m - freq n) ^ 2)
      + 2 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.erase m,
          c m ^ 3 * c n * (u m * conj (u n)).re / (freq m - freq n) ^ 2

lemma Cstep_ae_cell (hN : 0 < N) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < N) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ Ι ((m:ℝ)/N) ((m+1:ℝ)/N) → Cstep s N x = Csum s m

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.Dfun_eqOn_cell
statement:
lemma Dfun_eqOn_cell (hN : 0 < N) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < N) :
    EqOn (Dfun s N) (fun t => Csum s m - t ^ 2 / 2) (Ioo ((m:ℝ)/N) ((m+1:ℝ)/N))

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abel
statement:
lemma abel (hN : 0 < N) (r : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, Csum s m * (r ((m+1:ℝ)/N) - r ((m:ℝ)/N))
      = Csum s N * r 1 - ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N)

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abel_ibp_first
statement:
theorem abel_ibp_first (hN : 0 < N) {r g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x
      = r 1 * Dfun s N 1 - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x * Dfun s N x

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abel_ibp_second
statement:
theorem abel_ibp_second (hN : 0 < N) {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable)
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x
      = r 1 * Dfun s N 1 - g 1 * Efun s N 1 + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, h x * Efun s N x

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_stability
statement:
theorem ceiling_stability (hN : 0 < N) {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {M : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Efun s N x| ≤ M) :
    |∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x|
      ≤ |r 1| * |Dfun s N 1| + |g 1| * |Efun s N 1| + M * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.first_order_bound
statement:
theorem first_order_bound (hN : 0 < N) {r g : ℝ → ℝ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))

    |∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x|

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.cert_of_check
statement:
theorem cert_of_check (d : CertData) (hc : check d = true) (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK d.K S 0 d.encl) :
    |D1 S d.N| ≤ (d.bD1n : ℝ) / d.bD1d ∧ |E1 S d.N| ≤ (d.bE1n : ℝ) / d.bE1d ∧
    (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ d.N → |Dleft S d.N j| ≤ (d.b1n : ℝ) / d.b1d ∧ |Dright S d.N j| ≤ (d.b1n : ℝ) / d.b1d) ∧
    (∀ i j, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ d.N → 1 ≤ j → j ≤ d.N →
        |Egrid S d.N j| + |Dleft S d.N i| / d.N ≤ (d.b2n : ℝ) / d.b2d ∧ |Egrid S d.N j| + |Dright S d.N i| / d.N ≤ (d.b2n : ℝ) / d.b2d)

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.scaled_Dleft
statement:
lemma scaled_Dleft (hN : 0 < N) (j : ℕ) :
    (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * K) * Dleft S N j = 2 * N * (K * T S (j - 1)) - (j : ℝ) ^ 2 * K

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.scaled_Dright
statement:
lemma scaled_Dright (hN : 0 < N) (j : ℕ) :

statement:

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abs_Dfun_le_of_grid
Zeta23.PairCeiling.abs_Efun_le_of_grid
statement:
theorem abs_Efun_le_of_grid (hN : 0 < N) {B₂ : ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ i j, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ N → 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N →
        |Egrid S N j| + |Dleft S N i| / N ≤ B₂ ∧ |Egrid S N j| + |Dright S N i| / N ≤ B₂) :
    ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |Efun (massOf S N) N x| ≤ B₂

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.package_of_check
statement:
theorem package_of_check (d : CertData) (hc : check d = true) (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK d.K S 0 d.encl) :
    |Dfun (massOf S d.N) d.N 1| ≤ (d.bD1n : ℝ) / d.bD1d ∧ |Efun (massOf S d.N) d.N 1| ≤ (d.bE1n : ℝ) / d.bE1d ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |Dfun (massOf S d.N) d.N t| ≤ (d.b1n : ℝ) / d.b1d) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |Efun (massOf S d.N) d.N x| ≤ (d.b2n : ℝ) / d.b2d)

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_numeric
statement:
theorem ceiling_numeric (hN : 0 < N) {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable)
    {M p₁ c₀ d₁ e₁ a b c : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Efun s N x| ≤ M)
    (hD1 : |Dfun s N 1| ≤ d₁) (hE1 : |Efun s N 1| ≤ e₁)
    (ha : |r 1| ≤ a) (hb : |g 1| ≤ b) (hc : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x| ≤ c)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) ≤ p₁) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x ≤ p₁ + d₁ * a + e₁ * b + M * c

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_of_valid_at
statement:
theorem ceiling_of_valid_at (hN : 0 < N) {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {M p₁ c₀ : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Efun s N x| ≤ M)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) ≤ p₁) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x
      ≤ p₁ + (|r 1| * |Dfun s N 1| + |g 1| * |Efun s N 1| + M * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|)

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.Efun_cell
statement:
lemma Efun_cell (hN : 0 < N) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < N) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc ((m : ℝ) / N) ((m + 1 : ℝ) / N)) :
    Efun (massOf S N) N x = Egrid S N m + T S m / N * (x - (m : ℝ) / N) - (x ^ 3 - ((m : ℝ) / N) ^ 3) / 6

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abs_Efun_le_of_nearCUE
statement:
theorem abs_Efun_le_of_nearCUE (hN : 0 < N) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : NearCUE S N τ) :
    ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Efun (massOf S N) N x| ≤ 1 / (6 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) + τ / (2 * N)

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abs_Efun_one_le_of_nearCUE
statement:
theorem abs_Efun_one_le_of_nearCUE (hN : 0 < N) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : NearCUE S N τ) :
    |Efun (massOf S N) N 1| ≤ 1 / (6 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) + τ / (2 * N)

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abs_T_sub_le
statement:
lemma abs_T_sub_le (h : NearCUE S N τ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m + 1 ≤ N) :
    |(N : ℝ) * T S m - (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) / 2| ≤ m * τ

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.abs_U_sub_le
statement:
lemma abs_U_sub_le (h : NearCUE S N τ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ N) :
    |(N : ℝ) * U S m - ((m : ℝ) ^ 3 - m) / 6| ≤ (m : ℝ) * (m - 1) / 2 * τ

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_nearCUE
statement:
theorem ceiling_nearCUE (hN : 0 < N) (S : ℕ → ℝ) {τ d₁ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hS : NearCUE S N τ)
    (hD1 : |Dfun (massOf S N) N 1| ≤ d₁)
    {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {c₀ p : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, massOf S N j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) ≤ p) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x
      ≤ p + d₁ * |r 1| + (1 / (6 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) + τ / (2 * N)) * |g 1|
          + (1 / (6 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) + τ / (2 * N)) * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.cert_of_checkRows
statement:
theorem cert_of_checkRows (d : RowCertData) (hc : checkRows d = true) (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK d.K S 0 d.encl) :
    0 < d.N ∧ NearCUE S d.N ((d.tn : ℝ) / d.td) ∧ |Dfun (massOf S d.N) d.N 1| ≤ (d.dn : ℝ) / d.dd

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.rows_sound
statement:
lemma rows_sound {N K tn td : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (htd : 0 < td) :
    ∀ (l : List (ℤ × ℤ)) (j : ℕ), rowsOK N K tn td j l = true → EnclOK K S j l →
      ∀ j' : ℕ, j < j' → j' ≤ j + l.length → j' < N → |(N : ℝ) * S j' - j'| ≤ (tn : ℝ) / td

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.sums_sound
statement:
lemma sums_sound {K : ℕ} :
    ∀ (l : List (ℤ × ℤ)) (j : ℕ), EnclOK K S j l →
      (sumLo l : ℝ) ≤ K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l.length, S (j + i + 1) ∧
      (K : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l.length, S (j + i + 1) ≤ (sumHi l : ℝ)

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.LawN256_check
statement: theorem LawN256_check : checkRows LawN256 = true

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_law256
statement:
theorem ceiling_law256 (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK LawN256.K S 0 LawN256.encl)
    {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {c₀ p : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 256, massOf S 256 j * r ((j:ℝ)/256) ≤ p) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x
      ≤ p + (82395317 : ℝ) / 10 ^ 8 * |r 1|
          + (1 / (6 * (256 : ℝ) ^ 2) + ((3 : ℝ) / 10 ^ 40) / (2 * 256)) * |g 1|
          + (1 / (6 * (256 : ℝ) ^ 2) + ((3 : ℝ) / 10 ^ 40) / (2 * 256)) * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_law256_decimal
statement:
theorem ceiling_law256_decimal (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK LawN256.K S 0 LawN256.encl)
    {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {c₀ p : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 256, massOf S 256 j * r ((j:ℝ)/256) ≤ p) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x
      ≤ p + 0.82395317 * |r 1| + 2.5431316e-6 * |g 1| + 2.5431316e-6 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.lawN256_rows
statement:
theorem lawN256_rows (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK LawN256.K S 0 LawN256.encl) :
    NearCUE S 256 ((3 : ℝ) / 10 ^ 40) ∧ |Dfun (massOf S 256) 256 1| ≤ (82395317 : ℝ) / 10 ^ 8

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.D1_nonneg_of_edgeNonneg
statement:
theorem D1_nonneg_of_edgeNonneg (d : RowCertData) (hc : edgeNonneg d = true) (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK d.K S 0 d.encl) :

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.LawN256_edge
statement: theorem LawN256_edge : edgeNonneg LawN256 = true

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_law256_signed
statement:
theorem ceiling_law256_signed (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : EnclOK LawN256.K S 0 LawN256.encl)
    {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {c₀ p : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hr1 : 0 ≤ r 1)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 256, massOf S 256 j * r ((j:ℝ)/256) ≤ p) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x ≤ p + 2.5431316e-6 * |g 1| + 2.5431316e-6 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_nearCUE_signed
statement:
theorem ceiling_nearCUE_signed (hN : 0 < N) (S : ℕ → ℝ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hS : NearCUE S N τ)
    (hD1 : 0 ≤ Dfun (massOf S N) N 1)
    {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {c₀ p : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hr1 : 0 ≤ r 1)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, massOf S N j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) ≤ p) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x
      ≤ p + (1 / (6 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) + τ / (2 * N)) * |g 1| + (1 / (6 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) + τ / (2 * N)) * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|

name: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_signed
statement:
theorem ceiling_signed (hN : 0 < N) {r g h : ℝ → ℝ} {T : Set ℝ} (hT : T.Countable) {M p₁ c₀ : ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt r (g x) x) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (hgh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 \ T, HasDerivAt g (h x) x) (hh : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 1)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Efun s N x| ≤ M)
    (hr1 : 0 ≤ r 1) (hD1 : 0 ≤ Dfun s N 1)
    (hvalid : c₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, s j * r ((j:ℝ)/N) ≤ p₁) :
    c₀ + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x * x ≤ p₁ + |g 1| * |Efun s N 1| + M * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |h x|

statement:
theorem Gaux_continuous (hL : 0 < L) (hφc : Continuous φ)
    (hsupp : ∀ u, L / 2 ≤ |u| → φ u = 0) : Continuous (Gaux φ L T τ τ')

name: Zeta23.Poisson.Gaux_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Gaux_eq_zero (hL : 0 < L) (hsupp : ∀ u, L / 2 ≤ |u| → φ u = 0) {ξ : ℝ}
    (hξ : 1 ≤ |ξ|) : Gaux φ L T τ τ' ξ = 0

name: Zeta23.Poisson.Gaux_zero
statement:
theorem Gaux_zero (heven : ∀ u, φ (-u) = φ u) :
    Gaux φ L T τ τ' 0 = L * paperFT (fun u => ((φ u ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((τ - τ' : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: Zeta23.Poisson.cexp_bookkeeping
statement:
theorem cexp_bookkeeping (hL : L ≠ 0) (ξ u w : ℝ) :
    cexp (I * (τ * u + τ' * (L * ξ - u) - T * L * ξ)) * cexp (↑(-2 * π * ξ * w) * I)
      = cexp (I * ↑(τ - (T + w * (2 * π / L))) * u)
        * cexp (I * ↑(τ' - (T + w * (2 * π / L))) * ↑(L * ξ - u))

name: Zeta23.Poisson.fourier_Gaux
statement:
theorem fourier_Gaux (hL : 0 < L) (hφc : Continuous φ)
    (hsupp : ∀ u, L / 2 ≤ |u| → φ u = 0) (w : ℝ) :
    𝓕 (Gaux φ L T τ τ') w
      = paperFT (fun u => (φ u : ℂ)) ((τ - (T + w * (2 * π / L)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        * paperFT (fun u => (φ u : ℂ)) ((τ' - (T + w * (2 * π / L)) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: Zeta23.Poisson.hasSum_paperFT_mul_paperFT
statement:
theorem hasSum_paperFT_mul_paperFT {φ : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hφc : Continuous φ)
    (hsupp : ∀ u, L / 2 ≤ |u| → φ u = 0) (heven : ∀ u, φ (-u) = φ u)
    (hdecay : ∃ C, ∀ s : ℝ, ‖paperFT (fun u => (φ u : ℂ)) s‖ * (1 + s ^ 2) ≤ C)
    (T τ τ' : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℤ => paperFT (fun u => (φ u : ℂ)) ((τ - (T + k * (2 * π / L)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
                        * paperFT (fun u => (φ u : ℂ)) ((τ' - (T + k * (2 * π / L)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (L * paperFT (fun u => ((φ u ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((τ - τ' : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: Zeta23.Poisson.isBigO_of_decay
statement:
theorem isBigO_of_decay {g : ℝ → ℂ} {c h C : ℝ} (hh : h ≠ 0)

    g =O[cocompact ℝ] fun w : ℝ => |w| ^ (-2 : ℝ)

name: Zeta23.Taper.hasSum_phiHatR_mul

theorem hasSum_phiHatR_mul (hϱ : TaperProfile ϱ) (hw : 0 < w) (hwL : 2 * w ≤ L) (T τ τ' : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℤ => phiHatR ϱ L w (τ - (T + k * (2 * π / L)))
                          * phiHatR ϱ L w (τ' - (T + k * (2 * π / L))))
      (L * PhiR ϱ L w (τ - τ'))

name: Zeta23.Taper.hasSum_phiHatR_sq
statement:
theorem hasSum_phiHatR_sq (hϱ : TaperProfile ϱ) (hw : 0 < w) (hwL : 2 * w ≤ L) (T γ : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℤ => phiHatR ϱ L w (γ - (T + k * (2 * π / L))) ^ 2)
      (aConst ϱ L w * L ^ 2)

name: Zeta23.Taper.phiHat_decay

statement:
lemma Mform_integrableOn (hΦ : Continuous Φ) {u v : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : Continuous u)
    (hv : Continuous v) :
    IntegrableOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (Φ (q.1 - q.2)) ^ 2 * u q.1 * v q.2)
      ((Set.Icc T (2 * T)) ×ˢ (Set.Icc T (2 * T)))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.Mform_trinomial
statement:
lemma Mform_trinomial (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (hΦe : ∀ r, Φ (-r) = Φ r) {u v w : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) (hw : Continuous w) :
    Mform Φ T (u + v + w) (u + v + w) =
      Mform Φ T u u + Mform Φ T w w + 2 * Mform Φ T u w + 2 * Mform Φ T u v
        + 2 * Mform Φ T w v + Mform Φ T v v

lemma Mform_eq_iter (hΦ : Continuous Φ) {u v : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) :

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.abs_Mform_cos_le
statement:
theorem abs_Mform_cos_le (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ)
    (hΦint : Integrable (fun x => Φ x ^ 2)) {u : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) {B D : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ τ ∈ Icc T (2 * T), |u τ| ≤ B) (hD : ∀ τ ∈ Icc T (2 * T), |deriv u τ| ≤ D)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    |Mform Φ T u (fun t => Real.cos (t * y))| ≤ (4 * B + D * T) * (∫ x, Φ x ^ 2) / |y|

statement:

    (hΦint : Integrable (fun x => Φ x ^ 2)) {u : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) {B D : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc T (2 * T), |u τ| ≤ B) (hD : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc T (2 * T), |deriv u τ| ≤ D)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (θ : ℝ) :
    |Mform Φ T u (fun t => Real.cos (t * y + θ))| ≤ (4 * B + D * T) * (∫ x, Φ x ^ 2) / |y|

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.inner_ibp_phase
statement:
lemma inner_ibp_phase (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (θ τ : ℝ) :
    ∫ τ' in T..(2 * T), Φ (τ - τ') ^ 2 * Real.cos (τ' * y + θ)
      = (Φ (τ - 2 * T) ^ 2 * Real.sin (2 * T * y + θ) - Φ (τ - T) ^ 2 * Real.sin (T * y + θ)) / y
        + y⁻¹ * ∫ τ' in T..(2 * T), deriv (fun x => Φ x ^ 2) (τ - τ') * Real.sin (τ' * y + θ)

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.outer_ibp
statement:
lemma outer_ibp (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ) {u : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) (τ' : ℝ) :
    ∫ τ in T..(2 * T), u τ * deriv (fun x => Φ x ^ 2) (τ - τ')
      = u (2 * T) * Φ (2 * T - τ') ^ 2 - u T * Φ (T - τ') ^ 2
        - ∫ τ in T..(2 * T), deriv u τ * Φ (τ - τ') ^ 2

    ∫ Δ in Ioc 0 (2 * p.T), Mnear cϱ p B Δ
      ≤ B * ((∫ r in Ioi 0, psiA cϱ p r)
        + p.L / (2 * π) * ((∫ r in Ioi 0, psiA cϱ p r) + cϱ / p.w * Real.log (2 * p.T)))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.integral_Mtot_eq

    ∫ Δ in Ioi 0, Mtot cϱ p B Δ
      = (∫ Δ in Ioc 0 (2 * p.T), Mnear cϱ p B Δ) + ∫ Δ in Ioi (2 * p.T), Mfar cϱ p B Δ

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.log_two_mul_T_le

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.nu_grid_bound
statement:
theorem nu_grid_bound (hνc : Continuous ν) (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (hν : NuBound p B ν)
    (hBl : p.l ≤ B) (hL2l : p.L ≤ 2 * p.l)
    (hT : 2 * π * Real.exp 8 ≤ p.T) :
    ∫ τ in (p.I)ᶜ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range p.d, psiA cϱ p (τ - p.tau k)) * |ν τ|
      ≤ CN2 cϱ * (B * (p.L * p.l))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.nu_grid_bound_L
statement:
theorem nu_grid_bound_L (hνc : Continuous ν) (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (hν : NuBound p B ν)
    (hBL : p.L ≤ B)
    (hT : 2 * π * Real.exp 8 ≤ p.T) :
    ∫ τ in (p.I)ᶜ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range p.d, psiA cϱ p (τ - p.tau k)) * |ν τ|
      ≤ CN2 cϱ * (B * (p.L * (p.L + p.l)))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.nu_grid_bound_raw
statement:
theorem nu_grid_bound_raw (hνc : Continuous ν) (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (hν : NuBound p B ν)
    (hB8 : 8 ≤ B) (hT : 2 * π * Real.exp 8 ≤ p.T) :
    ∫ τ in (p.I)ᶜ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range p.d, psiA cϱ p (τ - p.tau k)) * |ν τ|
      ≤ 2 * (B * (2 + 2 * p.L + 25 / 2 * cϱ * p.L + cϱ * p.L ^ 2 / 2 + cϱ * p.L * p.l)
          + p.L * cϱ * B)

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.nu_weight_bound
statement:
theorem nu_weight_bound (hνc : Continuous ν) (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (hν : NuBound p B ν)
    (hBl : p.l ≤ B) (hL2l : p.L ≤ 2 * p.l)
    (hT : 1 ≤ p.T) {a : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc p.T (2 * p.T)) :
    ∫ τ : ℝ, psiA cϱ p (τ - a) * |ν τ|

statement:
theorem calE2_bound :

      LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F → p.L ≤ 2 * p.l → Continuous ν → NuBound p B ν → p.l ≤ B →

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.calE2_maj_bound_L
statement:
theorem calE2_maj_bound_L :

theorem setIntegral_compl_sqI_majK2_le (hνc : Continuous ν) (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F)

    (hN1 : ∀ a ∈ Icc p.T (2 * p.T), ∫ τ : ℝ, psiA cϱ p (τ - a) * |ν τ| ≤ M1)

theorem lem_ends_nu :

      |(p.L)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ k : Fin p.d, ∑ l : Fin p.d, GentryNu ν p F k l ^ 2 - MtotalNu ν p F|

      |(p.L)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ k : Fin p.d, ∑ l : Fin p.d, GentryNu ν p F k l ^ 2 - MtotalNu ν p F|

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.MV_primeRange
statement:
lemma MV_primeRange (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (X : ℝ) (x z : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
        (if n = m then (0:ℂ) else x n * conj (z m) / ((Real.log n - Real.log m : ℝ) : ℂ))‖
      ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ‖x n‖ ^ 2 * (2 * n))
          * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ‖z n‖ ^ 2 * (2 * n))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.MV_real
statement:
lemma MV_real (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (X c : ℝ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        u n * v m * Real.cos (c * (Real.log n - Real.log m)) / (Real.log n - Real.log m))|
      ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, u n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
          * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, v n ^ 2 * (2 * n)) ∧
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        u n * v m * Real.sin (c * (Real.log n - Real.log m)) / (Real.log n - Real.log m))|
      ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, u n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
          * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, v n ^ 2 * (2 * n))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.MV_size_le
statement:
lemma MV_size_le (hC : 0 ≤ C) (X : ℝ) {w : ℕ → ℝ} {W : ℝ} (hW : 0 ≤ W)
    (hw : ∀ n ∈ primeRange X, |w n| ≤ W) :
    C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, acoef n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
        * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * w n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
      ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (Λ n : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧
    C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * w n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
        * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, acoef n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
      ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (Λ n : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.inner_cos_cos
statement:
lemma inner_cos_cos (hT : 0 ≤ T) {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ T) (y y' : ℝ) :

      = (Jker (y - y') (x * y) (max (T - x) T) (min (2 * T - x) (2 * T))
          + Jker (y + y') (x * y) (max (T - x) T) (min (2 * T - x) (2 * T))) / 2

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.integral_sq_mul_sin_sub_sin
statement:

    ∫ x in a..b, Φ x ^ 2 * (Real.sin (c₁ + x * y) - Real.sin (c₂ + x * y'))
      = (Real.sin c₁ * ∫ x in a..b, Φ x ^ 2 * Real.cos (x * y))
        + (Real.cos c₁ * ∫ x in a..b, Φ x ^ 2 * Real.sin (x * y))
        - ((Real.sin c₂ * ∫ x in a..b, Φ x ^ 2 * Real.cos (x * y'))
          + (Real.cos c₂ * ∫ x in a..b, Φ x ^ 2 * Real.sin (x * y')))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.sub_mul_Aminus_eq
statement:
lemma sub_mul_Aminus_eq (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) {y y' : ℝ} (hθ : y - y' ≠ 0) :
    (y - y') * Aminus Φ T y y'
      = (Real.sin ((y - y') * (2 * T)) * Cm Φ T y + Real.cos ((y - y') * (2 * T)) * Sm Φ T y
          - (Real.sin ((y - y') * T) * Cm Φ T y' + Real.cos ((y - y') * T) * Sm Φ T y'))
        + (Real.sin ((y - y') * (2 * T)) * Cp Φ T y' + Real.cos ((y - y') * (2 * T)) * Sp Φ T y'
          - (Real.sin ((y - y') * T) * Cp Φ T y + Real.cos ((y - y') * T) * Sp Φ T y))

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.abs_inner_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_inner_sub_le (hΓ : Zeta23.GammaFacts) (hF : LocalHypsCore cϱ p F) (hT2 : 2 ≤ p.T)
    (hμl : ∀ τ ∈ Icc p.T (2 * p.T), |Zeta23.mu τ| ≤ p.l)
    {K : ℝ} (hK0 : 0 ≤ K)
    (hKinc : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → ∀ r : ℝ,
      |Zeta23.mu (t + r) - Zeta23.mu t| ≤ (K * |r| + 10 * r ^ 2) / t)
    (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ τ' in Ix p.T x, Zeta23.mu (x + τ') * Zeta23.mu τ')
        - ∫ τ' in Icc p.T (2 * p.T), Zeta23.mu τ' ^ 2|
      ≤ (1 + K) * p.l ^ 2 * |x| + 10 * p.l * x ^ 2

name: Zeta23.PrimeSide.mumu_core
statement:
theorem mumu_core (hΓ : Zeta23.GammaFacts) (hF : LocalHypsCore cϱ p F) (hT2 : 2 ≤ p.T)
    (hμl : ∀ τ ∈ Icc p.T (2 * p.T), |Zeta23.mu τ| ≤ p.l)
    {K : ℝ} (hK0 : 0 ≤ K)
    (hKinc : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → ∀ r : ℝ,
      |Zeta23.mu (t + r) - Zeta23.mu t| ≤ (K * |r| + 10 * r ^ 2) / t) :
    |Mform F.Phi p.T Zeta23.mu Zeta23.mu
        - 2 * π * F.b * p.L * ∫ τ in p.T..(2 * p.T), Zeta23.mu τ ^ 2|
      ≤ (1 + K) * p.l ^ 2 * (∫ x, F.Phi x ^ 2 * |x|)
        + 10 * p.l * ∫ x, F.Phi x ^ 2 * x ^ 2

    (hET : 1 / T ≤ E) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂)
    (hs1 : C₁ * E ≤ 1 / 2) (hs2 : C₂ * E ≤ 1 / 2) (hTA : 2 * π * A ≤ T)
    (h1 : |G - L * N| ≤ C₁ * (E * (L * N)))
    (h2 : |G2 - T * L / (2 * π) * (ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 / 3)| ≤ C₂ * (E * (T * L / (2 * π) * (ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 / 3))))

statement:
lemma tr2_pointwise (T L ℓ lT X E S I2 b G2 w CR Cμ Cu Cl : ℝ)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hl : 1 ≤ lT) (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log lT) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hℓl : lT ≤ ℓ) (hLl : L ≤ lT) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hL2w : 2 * w ≤ L) (hb1 : 1 - 2 * w / L ≤ b) (hble1 : b ≤ 1)
    (hE0 : 0 ≤ E) (hEw : w / L ≤ E) (hEmid : (lT ^ 2 + X) * Real.log lT / (T * lT) ≤ E)
    (hCR : 0 ≤ CR) (hCμ : 0 ≤ Cμ) (hCu : 0 ≤ Cu) (hCl : 0 ≤ Cl)
    (hR : |G2 - (2 * π * b * L * I2 + T / π * S)| ≤ CR * (L * lT * Real.log lT * (lT ^ 2 + X)))
    (hμ : |I2 - T * ℓ ^ 2 / (4 * π ^ 2)| ≤ Cμ * (T * ℓ ^ 2 / (4 * π ^ 2) / lT ^ 2))
    (hSup : S - L ^ 3 / 6 ≤ Cu * L ^ 2) (hSlo : -(Cl * L ^ 2) ≤ S - (L - 2 * w) ^ 3 / 6) :
    |G2 - T * L / (2 * π) * (ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 / 3)|
      ≤ (2 * π * CR + Cμ + 2 + 6 * (Cu + Cl + 2 * w)) * (E * (T * L / (2 * π) * (ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 / 3)))

        (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else acoef n * acoef m * Aminus Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m))|

name: Zeta23.Tail.one_side_sum_le
statement:
lemma one_side_sum_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (m : ι → ℕ) (key : ι → ℕ)
    {A₀ B D₀ : ℝ} (hA₀ : 0 ≤ A₀) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hD₀ : 2 ≤ D₀)
    (hx : ∀ ρ ∈ s, D₀ ≤ x ρ) (hkey_le : ∀ ρ ∈ s, (key ρ : ℝ) ≤ x ρ)
    (hkey_ge : ∀ ρ ∈ s, x ρ ≤ key ρ + 1)
    (hcount : ∀ j : ℕ, ∑ ρ ∈ s with key ρ = j, (m ρ : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * Real.log (B + j)) :
    ∑ ρ ∈ s, (m ρ : ℝ) * ((x ρ) ^ 3)⁻¹
      ≤ A₀ * ((2 * (D₀ ^ 3)⁻¹ + (D₀ ^ 2)⁻¹ / 2) * Real.log B
          + (2 * (D₀ ^ 2)⁻¹ + D₀⁻¹) / B)

statement:

    ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), ((D + i) ^ 3)⁻¹ ≤ (D ^ 3)⁻¹ + ((D ^ 2)⁻¹ - ((D + n) ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2

name: Zeta23.Tail.sum_window_weights_le
statement:
lemma sum_window_weights_le (F : Finset ℕ) {B D₀ : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hD₀ : 2 ≤ D₀)

    ∑ j ∈ F, ((max D₀ j) ^ 3)⁻¹ * Real.log (B + j)

Zeta23.Tail.two_sides_numeric

lemma two_sides_numeric {T : ℝ} (hT : T₀ ≤ T) :

    (hdecay : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, ∀ (r y : ℝ), |y| ≤ 1 / 2 → (r : ℂ) - I * y ≠ 0 →
      ‖P.phiHat T (r - I * y)‖ ≤ Real.exp (P.L T / 4) * C₁ T / ‖(r : ℂ) - I * y‖ ^ 2)
    (ha : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 0 < P.a T)
    (hconj : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, ∀ z : ℂ,
      P.phiHat T ((starRingEnd ℂ) z) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (P.phiHat T z)) :
    ∀ᶠ T in atTop, Assembly.TailInputs Z P T (theta0 A₀ (Real.exp (P.L T / 4) * C₁ T) T)

    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ Z.carrier) (htail : InTail T ρ.im) (k : Fin (P.d T)) :
    ‖uvec P T ρ k‖

statement:
theorem frhatD_pointwise (T L ℓ lT E N G2 A aa b J C₂ : ℝ)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hL : 0 < L) (hℓ1 : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hℓl : lT ≤ ℓ) (hN0 : 0 < N) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)
    (hET : 1 / T ≤ E) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂)
    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ aa) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (hJ0 : 0 ≤ J)
    (hTA : 4 * π * A ≤ T)
    (h2 : |G2 - T * L / (2 * π) * (b * ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 * J)|
      ≤ C₂ * (E * (T * L / (2 * π) * (b * ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 * J))))
    (hN : |N - T * ℓ / (2 * π)| ≤ A * lT) :
    max (G2 / (aa * L) ^ 2 - (cRatio (L / ℓ) aa b J)⁻¹ * N) 0
      ≤ (4 * π * A + 2 * C₂) * (E * ((cRatio (L / ℓ) aa b J)⁻¹ * N))

name: Zeta23.ThmD.ratioD_pointwise
statement:
theorem ratioD_pointwise (T L ℓ lT E N G G2 A aa b J C₁ C₂ : ℝ)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hL : 0 < L) (hℓ1 : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hℓl : lT ≤ ℓ) (hN0 : 0 < N) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)
    (hET : 1 / T ≤ E) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂)
    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ aa) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (hJ0 : 0 ≤ J)
    (hs1 : C₁ * E ≤ 1 / 2) (hs2 : C₂ * E ≤ 1 / 2) (hTA : 2 * π * A ≤ T)
    (h1 : |G - aa * L * N| ≤ C₁ * (E * (aa * L * N)))
    (h2 : |G2 - T * L / (2 * π) * (b * ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 * J)|
      ≤ C₂ * (E * (T * L / (2 * π) * (b * ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 * J))))
    (hN : |N - T * ℓ / (2 * π)| ≤ A * lT) :
    |G ^ 2 / G2 - cRatio (L / ℓ) aa b J * N|
      ≤ 2 * (2 * π * A + 5 * C₁ + C₂) * (E * (cRatio (L / ℓ) aa b J * N))

name: Zeta23.ThmD.tr2D_pointwise
statement:
theorem tr2D_pointwise (T L ℓ lT X E S I2 b J G2 w CR Cμ Cs : ℝ)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hl : 1 ≤ lT) (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log lT) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hℓl : lT ≤ ℓ) (hLl : L ≤ lT) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hL2w : 2 * w ≤ L)
    (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (hJ0 : 0 ≤ J)
    (hE0 : 0 ≤ E) (hEw : w / L ≤ E) (hEmid : (lT ^ 2 + X) * Real.log lT / (T * lT) ≤ E)
    (hCR : 0 ≤ CR) (hCμ : 0 ≤ Cμ) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hR : |G2 - (2 * π * b * L * I2 + T / π * S)| ≤ CR * (L * lT * Real.log lT * (lT ^ 2 + X)))
    (hμ : |I2 - T * ℓ ^ 2 / (4 * π ^ 2)| ≤ Cμ * (T * ℓ ^ 2 / (4 * π ^ 2) / lT ^ 2))
    (hSJ : |S - L ^ 3 * J / 2| ≤ Cs * L ^ 2) :
    |G2 - T * L / (2 * π) * (b * ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 * J)|
      ≤ (4 * π * CR + 2 * Cμ + 4 * Cs) * (E * (T * L / (2 * π) * (b * ℓ ^ 2 + L ^ 2 * J)))

      MtotalChiA κ q c p F
        = Mform F.Phi p.T (muq κ q) (muq κ q)
          + Mform F.Phi p.T (PXc c p.X) (PXc c p.X)
          + 2 * Mform F.Phi p.T (muq κ q) (PXc c p.X)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.integral_phiHat_sq_mul_cos_shift_core
statement:
lemma integral_phiHat_sq_mul_cos_shift_core (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (t y : ℝ) :
    ∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * Real.cos ((t + r) * y) = 2 * π * F.Aphi y * Real.cos (t * y)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.integral_phiHat_sq_mul_sin_core
statement:
lemma integral_phiHat_sq_mul_sin_core (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (y : ℝ) :
    ∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * Real.sin (r * y) = 0

name: Zeta23.ThmE.integral_phiHat_sq_mul_sin_shift_core
statement:
lemma integral_phiHat_sq_mul_sin_shift_core (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (t y : ℝ) :
    ∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * Real.sin ((t + r) * y) = 2 * π * F.Aphi y * Real.sin (t * y)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.integral_phiHat_sq_re_twist_core
statement:
lemma integral_phiHat_sq_re_twist_core (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (z : ℂ) (t y : ℝ) :
    ∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * (z * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ((t + r) * y))).re
      = 2 * π * F.Aphi y * (z * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (t * y))).re

name: Zeta23.ThmE.lem_ends_chi
statement:
theorem lem_ends_chi (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hcheb : ChebyshevMertens)
    (hc : CoeffOK q c) (hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, EventuallyAtCore cϱ lam (fun p F =>
      |trGt2ChiA κ q c p F - MtotalChiA κ q c p F|
        ≤ C * (p.L * Zeta23.l p.T * Real.log (Zeta23.l p.T) * (Zeta23.l p.T ^ 2 + p.X)))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.muq_abs_le
statement:
lemma muq_abs_le (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ C T₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ p : Setting, T₀ ≤ p.T →
      ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc p.T (2 * p.T), |muq κ q τ| ≤ C * Zeta23.l p.T

name: Zeta23.ThmE.muq_increment_bound
statement:
lemma muq_increment_bound (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → ∀ r : ℝ,
      |muq κ q (t + r) - muq κ q t| ≤ K * (|r| + r ^ 2) / t

name: Zeta23.ThmE.muq_linear_bound
statement:
lemma muq_linear_bound (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ τ, |muq κ q τ| ≤ M + |τ|

name: Zeta23.ThmE.muq_nonneg_eventually
statement:
lemma muq_nonneg_eventually (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ τ₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ₀ ∧ ∀ x, τ₀ ≤ x → 0 ≤ muq κ q x

name: Zeta23.ThmE.muq_nuBound
statement:
lemma muq_nuBound (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ C₀ T₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ p : Setting, T₀ ≤ p.T → ∀ τ : ℝ,
      |muq κ q τ| ≤ C₀ * Zeta23.l p.T + max (Real.log (|τ| / (4 * p.T))) 0

name: Zeta23.ThmE.muq_part_bound
statement:
lemma muq_part_bound (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) {K : ℝ}
    (_hK0 : 0 ≤ K)
    (hK : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → ∀ r : ℝ, |muq κ q (t + r) - muq κ q t| ≤ K * (|r| + r ^ 2) / t)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    |(∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * muq κ q (t + r)) - 2 * π * F.a * p.L * muq κ q t|
      ≤ K * ((∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * |r|) + (∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * r ^ 2)) / t

name: Zeta23.ThmE.muq_part_integrable
statement:
lemma muq_part_integrable (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 < t) :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun r => F.phiHat r ^ 2 * muq κ q (t + r))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.prop_trace_chi
statement:
theorem prop_trace_chi (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hcheb : ChebyshevMertens)
    (hc : CoeffOK q c) (hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) (A : ℝ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, EventuallyAtCore cϱ lam (fun p F => ∀ N : ℝ,
      |N - p.T / (2 * Real.pi) * ell1q q p.T| ≤ A * Real.log p.T →
      |trGtChiA κ q c p F - F.a * p.L * N| ≤ C * (p.L * Real.sqrt p.X))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.sum_P_part_chi_bound
statement:
lemma sum_P_part_chi_bound (hF : LocalHypsCoreW cϱ p F) (hc : CoeffOK q c) :
    |∑ k ∈ Finset.range p.d, ∫ r, F.phiHat r ^ 2 * PXc c p.X (p.tau k + r)|
      ≤ p.L ^ 2 / Real.log 2 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊,
          (Λ n : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.AminusPh_self
statement: lemma AminusPh_self (y y' φ : ℝ) : AminusPh Φ T y y' φ φ = Aminus Φ T y y'

name: Zeta23.ThmE.MV_real_ph
statement:
lemma MV_real_ph (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (X cc : ℝ) (u v φv : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        u n * v m * Real.cos (cc * (Real.log n - Real.log m) - (φv n - φv m))
          / (Real.log n - Real.log m))|
      ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, u n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
          * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, v n ^ 2 * (2 * n)) ∧
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        u n * v m * Real.sin (cc * (Real.log n - Real.log m) - (φv n - φv m))
          / (Real.log n - Real.log m))|
      ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, u n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
          * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, v n ^ 2 * (2 * n))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.MV_size_le₂
statement:
lemma MV_size_le₂ (hC : 0 ≤ C) (X : ℝ) {w₁ w₂ : ℕ → ℝ} {W : ℝ} (hW : 0 ≤ W)
    (hw₁ : ∀ n ∈ primeRange X, |w₁ n| ≤ 1) (hw₂ : ∀ n ∈ primeRange X, |w₂ n| ≤ W) :
    C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * w₁ n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
        * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * w₂ n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
      ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (Λ n : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧
    C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * w₂ n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
        * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * w₁ n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
      ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (Λ n : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.Mform_PXc_PXc
statement:
lemma Mform_PXc_PXc (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (X : ℝ) :
    Mform Φ T (PXc c X) (PXc c X)
      = (1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) *
        ((∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * ‖c n‖) ^ 2 * Aminus Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log n))
          + (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
              (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else (acoef n * ‖c n‖) * (acoef m * ‖c m‖)
                * AminusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (c n).arg (c m).arg))
          + ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
              (acoef n * ‖c n‖) * (acoef m * ‖c m‖)
                * AplusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (c n).arg (c m).arg)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.Mform_cos_cos_ph
statement:
lemma Mform_cos_cos_ph (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (y y' φ φ' : ℝ) :
    Mform Φ T (fun τ => Real.cos (τ * y - φ)) (fun τ => Real.cos (τ * y' - φ'))
      = (AminusPh Φ T y y' φ φ' + AplusPh Φ T y y' φ φ') / 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.O1_bound_chi
statement:
theorem O1_bound_chi {C : ℝ} (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (hΦ2 : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2) (hc1 : ∀ n, ‖c n‖ ≤ 1) (X : ℝ) :
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
        (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else (acoef n * ‖c n‖) * (acoef m * ‖c m‖)
          * AminusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (c n).arg (c m).arg)|
      ≤ 16 * C * (∫ x, Φ x ^ 2) * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (Λ n : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.O2_estimate_chi
statement:
lemma O2_estimate_chi (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (hΦ2 : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2)
    (hc1 : ∀ n, ‖c n‖ ≤ 1) (X T : ℝ) :
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * ‖c n‖) * (acoef m * ‖c m‖)
        * AplusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (c n).arg (c m).arg|
      ≤ (∫ x, Φ x ^ 2) / Real.log 2 * (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, acoef n) ^ 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.PXc_eq_sum
statement:
lemma PXc_eq_sum (c : ℕ → ℂ) (X τ : ℝ) :
    PXc c X τ = -(1 / π) * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X,
      acoef n * ‖c n‖ * Real.cos (τ * Real.log n - (c n).arg)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.abs_AplusPh_le
Zeta23.ThmE.continuous_Jker_offset_ph
statement:
lemma continuous_Jker_offset_ph (θ y ψ T : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
      Jker θ (x * y - ψ) (max (T - x) T) (min (2 * T - x) (2 * T)))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.cpow_neg_half_sub_I_mul
statement:
lemma cpow_neg_half_sub_I_mul {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (τ : ℝ) :
    (n : ℂ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) - Complex.I * τ)
      = (((Real.sqrt n)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((-(τ * Real.log n) : ℝ) * Complex.I)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.diag_estimate_chi
statement:
lemma diag_estimate_chi (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (hΦ2 : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2)
    (hΦabs : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2 * |x|) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hFT : ∀ y, ∫ x, Φ x ^ 2 * Real.cos (x * y) = 2 * π * g y) (hc1 : ∀ n, ‖c n‖ ≤ 1) (X : ℝ) :
    |(1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) * (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (acoef n * ‖c n‖) ^ 2 * Aminus Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log n))
        - T / π * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, acoef n ^ 2 * ‖c n‖ ^ 2 * g (Real.log n)|
      ≤ (1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) * (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, acoef n ^ 2) * ∫ x, Φ x ^ 2 * |x|

name: Zeta23.ThmE.inner_cos_cos_ph
statement:
lemma inner_cos_cos_ph (hT : 0 ≤ T) {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ T) (y y' φ φ' : ℝ) :
    ∫ τ' in Ix T x, Real.cos ((x + τ') * y - φ) * Real.cos (τ' * y' - φ')
      = (Jker (y - y') (x * y - (φ - φ')) (max (T - x) T) (min (2 * T - x) (2 * T))
          + Jker (y + y') (x * y - (φ + φ')) (max (T - x) T) (min (2 * T - x) (2 * T))) / 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.prop_PP_chi
statement:
theorem prop_PP_chi (hcheb : Zeta23.ChebyshevMertens) (hMV : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ Zeta23.MVHilbert C)
    (hc : CoeffUnimodular q c) (hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, EventuallyAtCore cϱ lam (fun p F =>
      |Mform F.Phi p.T (PXc c p.X) (PXc c p.X) - p.T / π * sumA2gCoprime q p.X F.g|
        ≤ C * (p.L ^ 2 * p.X))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.prop_PP_chi_uniform
statement:
theorem prop_PP_chi_uniform (hcheb : Zeta23.ChebyshevMertens) (hMV : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ Zeta23.MVHilbert C)
    (hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C T₀ : ℝ, ∀ (q : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ), CoeffUnimodular q c →
      ∀ (p : Setting) (F : LocalFun), p.lam = lam → T₀ ≤ p.T → LocalHypsCore cϱ p F →
      |Mform F.Phi p.T (PXc c p.X) (PXc c p.X) - p.T / π * sumA2gCoprime q p.X F.g|
        ≤ C * (p.L ^ 2 * p.X)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.sub_mul_AminusPh_eq
statement:
lemma sub_mul_AminusPh_eq (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) {y y' : ℝ} (hθ : y - y' ≠ 0)
    (φ φ' : ℝ) :
    (y - y') * AminusPh Φ T y y' φ φ'
      = (Real.sin ((y - y') * (2 * T) - (φ - φ')) * Cm Φ T y
          + Real.cos ((y - y') * (2 * T) - (φ - φ')) * Sm Φ T y
          - (Real.sin ((y - y') * T - (φ - φ')) * Cm Φ T y'
            + Real.cos ((y - y') * T - (φ - φ')) * Sm Φ T y'))
        + (Real.sin ((y - y') * (2 * T) - (φ - φ')) * Cp Φ T y'
          + Real.cos ((y - y') * (2 * T) - (φ - φ')) * Sp Φ T y'
          - (Real.sin ((y - y') * T - (φ - φ')) * Cp Φ T y
            + Real.cos ((y - y') * T - (φ - φ')) * Sp Φ T y))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.sumA2gCoprime_lower
statement:
theorem sumA2gCoprime_lower (hchebq : ChebyshevMertensCoprime q) (_hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, EventuallyAt cϱ lam (fun p F =>
      (p.L - 2 * p.w) ^ 3 / 6 - C * p.L ^ 2 ≤ sumA2gCoprime q p.X F.g)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.sumA2gCoprime_upper
statement:
theorem sumA2gCoprime_upper (hchebq : ChebyshevMertensCoprime q) (_hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, EventuallyAtCore cϱ lam (fun p F =>
      sumA2gCoprime q p.X F.g ≤ p.L ^ 3 / 6 + C * p.L ^ 2)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.sum_w_eq_sumA2gCoprime
statement:
lemma sum_w_eq_sumA2gCoprime (hc : CoeffUnimodular q c) (X : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, acoef n ^ 2 * ‖c n‖ ^ 2 * g (Real.log n) = sumA2gCoprime q X g

name: Zeta23.ThmDE.sumA2gCoprime_close
statement:
theorem sumA2gCoprime_close {q : ℕ} (hchebq : ThmE.ChebyshevMertensCoprime q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (L X : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 8 ≤ L → X = Real.exp L →
      Differentiable ℝ g → Continuous (deriv g) → (∀ y : ℝ, |deriv g y| ≤ 2) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, L ≤ y → g y = 0) →
      |ThmE.sumA2gCoprime q X g - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..L, g y * y| ≤ C * L ^ 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.Mform_mu_PXc_eq
statement:
lemma Mform_mu_PXc_eq {Φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hΦ : Continuous Φ) {u : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : Continuous u)
    (c : ℕ → ℂ) (X T : ℝ) :
    Mform Φ T u (PXc c X)
      = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊X⌋₊, (-(1 / Real.pi) * ((Λ n : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))))
          * ((c n).re * Mform Φ T u (fun t => Real.cos (t * Real.log n))
             + (c n).im * Mform Φ T u (fun t => Real.sin (t * Real.log n)))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.prop_cross_muP_chi_proved
statement:
theorem prop_cross_muP_chi_proved {κ q : ℕ} {c : ℕ → ℂ} {cϱ lam : ℝ}
    (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hcheb : ChebyshevMertens) (hc : CoeffOK q c) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, EventuallyAtCore cϱ lam (fun p F =>
      |Mform F.Phi p.T (muq κ q) (PXc c p.X)| ≤ C * (Zeta23.l p.T * Real.sqrt p.X))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.abs_inner_sub_le_chi
statement:
theorem abs_inner_sub_le_chi (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hT2 : 2 ≤ p.T)
    {A : ℝ} (hA0 : 0 ≤ A)
    (hμl : ∀ τ ∈ Icc p.T (2 * p.T), |muq κ q τ| ≤ A)
    {K : ℝ} (hK0 : 0 ≤ K)
    (hKinc : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → ∀ r : ℝ,
      |muq κ q (t + r) - muq κ q t| ≤ K * (|r| + r ^ 2) / t)
    (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ τ' in Ix p.T x, muq κ q (x + τ') * muq κ q τ')
        - ∫ τ' in Icc p.T (2 * p.T), muq κ q τ' ^ 2|
      ≤ (A ^ 2 + A * K) * |x| + A * K * x ^ 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.mumu_core_chi
statement:
theorem mumu_core_chi (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hF : LocalHypsCore cϱ p F) (hT2 : 2 ≤ p.T)
    {A : ℝ} (hA0 : 0 ≤ A)
    (hμl : ∀ τ ∈ Icc p.T (2 * p.T), |muq κ q τ| ≤ A)
    {K : ℝ} (hK0 : 0 ≤ K)
    (hKinc : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ t → ∀ r : ℝ,
      |muq κ q (t + r) - muq κ q t| ≤ K * (|r| + r ^ 2) / t) :
    |Mform F.Phi p.T (muq κ q) (muq κ q)
        - 2 * π * F.b * p.L * ∫ τ in p.T..(2 * p.T), muq κ q τ ^ 2|
      ≤ (A ^ 2 + A * K) * (∫ x, F.Phi x ^ 2 * |x|)
        + A * K * ∫ x, F.Phi x ^ 2 * x ^ 2

name: Zeta23.ThmE.prop_mumu_chi
statement:
theorem prop_mumu_chi {κ q : ℕ} {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hΓq : GammaFactsChi κ q) (hc : CoeffOK q c)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, EventuallyAtCore cϱ lam (fun p F =>
      |Mform F.Phi p.T (muq κ q) (muq κ q)
          - 2 * π * F.b * p.L * ∫ τ in p.T..(2 * p.T), muq κ q τ ^ 2|
        ≤ C * (Zeta23.l p.T ^ 2 * Real.log p.L))

name: Zeta23.ThmE.tr1'_chi

name: Zeta23.ThmE.seamBChi
statement:
theorem seamBChi {Z : ZeroConfig} {T : ℝ} (hGzGp : Z.Gz P T = GpChi P κ q c T)
    (ha : 0 < P.a T) (hL : 0 < P.L T) (hℓ₁ : 0 < ell1q q T)
    {C₁ C₂ ET RN : ℝ}
    (htr1 : |trGtildeChi P κ q c T - P.a T * P.L T * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)|
      ≤ C₁ * (P.L T * Real.sqrt (P.X T)))
    (hK : 0 ≤ 1 + C₂ * ET)
    (htr2 : trGtildeSqChi P κ q c T - mainTr2Chi P q T ≤ C₂ * ET * mainTr2Chi P q T)
    (hRvM : T * ell1q q T / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) + RN) :
    |RHLinalg.rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T)) - (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)|
        ≤ C₁ * Real.sqrt (P.X T) / P.a T ∧
    RHLinalg.frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Gz P T))
      ≤ (1 / lam1q P q T + lam1q P q T / 3) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)
        + (1 / lam1q P q T + lam1q P q T / 3) * (((1 + C₂ * ET) / P.a T ^ 2 - 1)
            * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) + (1 + C₂ * ET) / P.a T ^ 2 * RN)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.thmE_A_abstract
statement:
theorem thmE_A_abstract (Z : ZeroConfig) (κ : ℕ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (cf : ℕ → ℂ)
    (P : Params) (hP : P.Valid) (hlam : P.lam < 1)
    (hRvM : RiemannVonMangoldtChi q Z)
    (hTr : ThmTracesHypChi P κ q cf Z)
    (hBlock : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, BlockInputs Z P T)
    (θ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) (hTail : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, TailInputs Z P T (θ₀ T))
    (hθ₀ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, θ₀ T ≤ C * l T * T ^ (P.lam / 2 - 1))
    (hNII : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, (NII Z T : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.sqrt T * l T)
    (hGzGp : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, Z.Gz P T = GpChi P κ q cf T)
    (ha : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 1 - 2 * P.w / P.L T ≤ P.a T ∧ P.a T ≤ 1)
    (hcalE : Tendsto P.calE atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀, (Hfun P.lam - ε) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ Z.N0star T (2 * T)

name: Zeta23.ThmE.thmE_BC_core
statement:
theorem thmE_BC_core (Z : ZeroConfig) (κ : ℕ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (cf : ℕ → ℂ)
    (P : Params) (hP : P.Valid) (hlam : P.lam < 1)
    (hRvM : RiemannVonMangoldtChi q Z)
    (hTr : ThmTracesHypChi P κ q cf Z)
    (hBlock : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, BlockInputs Z P T)
    (θ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) (hTail : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, TailInputs Z P T (θ₀ T))
    (hθ₀ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, θ₀ T ≤ C * l T * T ^ (P.lam / 2 - 1))
    (hNII : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T in atTop, (NII Z T : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.sqrt T * l T)
    (hGzGp : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, Z.Gz P T = GpChi P κ q cf T)
    (hcalE : Tendsto P.calE atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ, R =o[atTop] (fun T => (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
        (2 * Ffun P.lam - 1) * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - 2 * R T ≤ Z.N0s T (2 * T) ∧
        Ffun P.lam * (Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - R T ≤ Z.Nd T (2 * T)

theorem count_certificate_c3_fn (κ : ℝ) {N NII tr fr B lower : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hfr0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 0 ≤ fr T)
    (h0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
      6 * tr T - fr T - 3 * N T - 5 * NII T - B T * (6 + 2 * Real.sqrt (fr T) + B T) ≤ 2 * lower T)
    (hB0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 0 ≤ B T)
    (hBto : Tendsto B atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hNII_o : NII =o[atTop] N)
    (hNtop : Tendsto N atTop atTop)
    (htrace : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop, (1 - δ) * N T ≤ tr T)
    (hfrob : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop, fr T ≤ (κ + δ) * N T) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀, (3 / 2 - κ / 2 - ε) * N T ≤ lower T

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.count_certificate_fn
statement:
theorem count_certificate_fn (κ : ℝ) {N NII tr fr B lower : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hfr0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 0 ≤ fr T)
    (h0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop,
      4 * tr T - fr T - 2 * N T - 3 * NII T - B T * (4 + 2 * Real.sqrt (fr T) + B T) ≤ lower T)
    (hB0 : ∀ᶠ T in atTop, 0 ≤ B T)
    (hBto : Tendsto B atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hNII_o : NII =o[atTop] N)
    (hNtop : Tendsto N atTop atTop)
    (htrace : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop, (1 - δ) * N T ≤ tr T)
    (hfrob : ∀ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ᶠ T in atTop, fr T ≤ (κ + δ) * N T) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀, (2 - κ - ε) * N T ≤ lower T

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.lamLogPow_le
statement:
lemma lamLogPow_le : ∀ (k n : ℕ), (lamLog ^ k) n ≤ Real.log n ^ k * (Λ ^ k) n
  | 0, n => by simp
  | k + 1, n => by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · simp
      rw [pow_succ lamLog k, pow_succ (Λ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) k, pow_succ (Real.log (n:ℝ)) k,
        ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply, ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply, mul_sum]
      refine sum_le_sum fun x hx => ?_
      have hx1 : x.1 ∣ n := Nat.fst_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hx |> Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors
      have hx2 : x.2 ∣ n := Nat.snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hx |> Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors
      have hx1pos : 0 < x.1 := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hx1 hn
      have hx2pos : 0 < x.2 := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hx2 hn
      have hl1 : Real.log x.1 ≤ Real.log n :=
        Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hx1pos) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_dvd hn hx1)
      have hl2 : Real.log x.2 ≤ Real.log n :=
        Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hx2pos) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_dvd hn hx2)
      have h01 : 0 ≤ Real.log x.1 := Real.log_natCast_nonneg _
      have h02 : 0 ≤ Real.log x.2 := Real.log_natCast_nonneg _
      rw [lamLog_apply]
      calc (lamLog ^ k) x.1 * (Λ x.2 * Real.log x.2)
          ≤ (Real.log x.1 ^ k * (Λ ^ k) x.1) * (Λ x.2 * Real.log x.2)

lemma lamPow_eq_zero_of_cardFactors_lt : ∀ {m n : ℕ}, Ω n < m → (Λ ^ m) n = 0
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | m + 1, n, h => by
      rw [pow_succ, ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply]
      refine sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_
      by_cases hb : Λ x.2 = 0
      · rw [hb, mul_zero]
      · have h1

lemma lamPow_le_log_pow : ∀ (m n : ℕ), (Λ ^ m) n ≤ Real.log n ^ m
  | 0, n => by
      rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, ArithmeticFunction.one_apply]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | m + 1, n => by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · simp
      rw [pow_succ, ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply]
      have hlogn : 0 ≤ Real.log n := Real.log_natCast_nonneg n
      calc ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (Λ ^ m) x.1 * Λ x.2
          ≤ ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, Real.log n ^ m * Λ x.2

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.sum_Ioc_pow_apply_le
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_pow_apply_le {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : SubmultWeight w)
    (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (X : ℕ) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ N ∈ Ioc 0 X, (f ^ (m + 1)) N * w N ≤ (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 X, f n * w n) ^ (m + 1)
  | 0 => by simp
  | m + 1 => by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 X, f n * w n := sum_nonneg fun n _ => mul_nonneg (hf n) (hw.nonneg n)
      calc ∑ N ∈ Ioc 0 X, (f ^ (m + 1 + 1)) N * w N
          = ∑ N ∈ Ioc 0 X, (f ^ (m + 1) * f) N * w N

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.pow_add_mul_pow_le
statement:
lemma pow_add_mul_pow_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, a ^ (m + 1) + (m + 1) * a ^ m * b ≤ (a + b) ^ (m + 1)
  | 0 => by simp
  | m + 1 => by
      have ih := pow_add_mul_pow_le ha hb m
      have hab : 0 ≤ a + b := add_nonneg ha hb
      have ham : 0 ≤ a ^ m := pow_nonneg ha m
      have key : a ^ (m + 1) ≤ (a + b) ^ (m + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha (by linarith) _
      calc a ^ (m + 1 + 1) + (↑(m + 1) + 1) * a ^ (m + 1) * b
          = a * (a ^ (m + 1) + (m + 1) * a ^ m * b) + a ^ (m + 1) * b

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.sq_sum_range_le_sum_two_pow_mul_sq
statement:
lemma sq_sum_range_le_sum_two_pow_mul_sq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∑ i ∈ range n, a i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, 2 ^ (i + 1) * a i ^ 2
  | 0, a => by simp
  | n + 1, a => by
      rw [sum_range_succ' a, sum_range_succ' (fun i => (2:ℝ) ^ (i + 1) * a i ^ 2)]
      have ih := sq_sum_range_le_sum_two_pow_mul_sq n (fun i => a (i + 1))
      have h2 : (∑ i ∈ range n, a (i + 1) + a 0) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (∑ i ∈ range n, a (i + 1)) ^ 2 + 2 * a 0 ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (∑ i ∈ range n, a (i + 1) - a 0)]
      calc (∑ i ∈ range n, a (i + 1) + a 0) ^ 2
          ≤ 2 * (∑ i ∈ range n, 2 ^ (i + 1) * a (i + 1) ^ 2) + 2 * a 0 ^ 2

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.term_bound
statement:

    2 ^ m * x ^ (2 * m) * u ^ m * ((u + m * KM) ^ m / m.factorial)
      ≤ (4 * x ^ 2 * u ^ 2) ^ m / m.factorial + (4 * Real.exp 1 * KM * x ^ 2 * u) ^ m

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.two_pow_length_le_prod
statement:
lemma two_pow_length_le_prod : ∀ (L : List ℕ), (∀ p ∈ L, 2 ≤ p) → 2 ^ L.length ≤ L.prod
  | [], _ => by simp
  | a :: L, h => by
      have ha : 2 ≤ a := h a (by simp)
      have ih := two_pow_length_le_prod L fun p hp => h p (by simp [hp])
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.prod_cons, pow_succ]
      calc 2 ^ L.length * 2 ≤ L.prod * a

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.LSeries_xiCoeffJ
statement:
theorem LSeries_xiCoeffJ : ∃ R₀ : ℝ, 0 < R₀ ∧ ∀ Λs : ℂ, R₀ ≤ ‖Λs‖ → ∀ s : ℂ, 5 / 4 ≤ s.re →
    Summable (fun N : ℕ => ‖xiCoeffJ Λs N‖ * (N : ℝ) ^ (-s.re)) ∧
    Λs - LSeries (fun n => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) s ≠ 0 ∧
    LSeries (fun N => xiCoeffJ Λs N) s
      = LSeries (fun n => ((Λ n * Real.log n : ℝ) : ℂ)) s / (Λs - LSeries (fun n => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) s)

      Λs - LSeries (fun n => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) s ≠ 0 ∧
      LSeries (fun N => xiCoeffJ Λs N) s
        = LSeries (fun n => ((Λ n * Real.log n : ℝ) : ℂ)) s / (Λs - LSeries (fun n => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) s)

    |Tk (j + 1) u - u ^ (2 * j + 2) / (2 * j + 2).factorial| ≤ C * (1 + u) ^ (2 * j + 1)
  | 0 => ⟨2 * KM, by positivity [KM_nonneg], fun u hu => by simpa using Tk_one_asymp u hu⟩

theorem norm_sq_xiCoeff_squarefree {N : ℕ} (hN : Squarefree N) (hk : 2 ≤ ω N) (Λs : ℂ)
    (hΛ : Λs ≠ 0) :
    ‖xiCoeff Λs N‖ ^ 2 = (‖Λs‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (ω N) * ((((ω N - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 2) / (ω N).factorial)
                           * (lamLog ^ (ω N)) N * Real.log N ^ 2

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.pow_apply_squarefree
statement:

      (f ^ k) N = if ω N = k then (k.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, f p else 0
  | 0, N, hN => by
      rw [pow_zero, ArithmeticFunction.one_apply]
      by_cases h1 : N = 1
      · subst h1; simp
      · have hω : ω N ≠ 0

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.xiCoeff_prime
statement:
theorem xiCoeff_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (Λs : ℂ) :
    xiCoeff Λs p = -(Real.log p : ℂ) + Λs⁻¹ * (Real.log p : ℂ) ^ 2

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.xiCoeff_squarefree
statement:
theorem xiCoeff_squarefree {N : ℕ} (hN : Squarefree N) (hk : 2 ≤ ω N) (Λs : ℂ) :
    xiCoeff Λs N = ((ω N - 1).factorial : ℂ) * (Λs⁻¹) ^ (ω N) * (Real.log N : ℂ)
                     * ((∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, Real.log p : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Dsum_le
statement:
theorem Dsum_le {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : ∀ (m : ℕ) {u : ℝ}, 0 ≤ u →
    Dsum (m + 1) p u ≤ (m + 1) * (2 * Real.log p / p) * Gb m u ^ m

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Dsum_zero
statement: lemma Dsum_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (u : ℝ) : Dsum 0 p u = 0

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Gb_ge_one
statement: lemma Gb_ge_one {m : ℕ} {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : 1 ≤ Gb m u

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Gb_mono_u
statement: lemma Gb_mono_u (m : ℕ) : Monotone (Gb m)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Gb_nonneg

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Gb_succ
statement: lemma Gb_succ (m : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : Gb (m + 1) u = Gb m u + KM

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Nsf_le
statement:
theorem Nsf_le : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → Nsf (m + 1) u ≤ C * Gb m u ^ m
  | 0 => by
      refine ⟨Cdef / Real.log 2, div_nonneg (by unfold Cdef; norm_num) (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)), fun u hu => ?_⟩
      unfold Nsf SdivP
      rw [pow_one, pow_zero, mul_one]
      calc ∑ N ∈ (Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊).filter (fun N => ¬ Squarefree N), Λ N / N
          ≤ ∑ N ∈ (Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊).filter (fun N => ¬ N.Prime), Λ N / N

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Nsf_le_poly
statement: theorem Nsf_le_poly (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → Nsf m u ≤ C * (1 + u) ^ (m - 1)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Nsf_nonneg
statement: lemma Nsf_nonneg (m : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Nsf m u

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.SdivP_eq_sum_ite
statement:
lemma SdivP_eq_sum_ite (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (u : ℝ) :
    SdivP f P u = ∑ N ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊, f N * (if P N then ((N:ℕ):ℝ)⁻¹ else 0)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.SdivP_mono_pred
statement:
lemma SdivP_mono_pred {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) {P Q : ℕ → Prop} [DecidablePred P]
    [DecidablePred Q] (hPQ : ∀ n, P n → Q n) (u : ℝ) : SdivP f P u ≤ SdivP f Q u

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.SdivP_mono_u

lemma SdivP_mono_u {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.SdivP_mul_le
statement:
theorem SdivP_mul_le {g f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} (hg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g n) (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n)
    (P Q : ℕ → Prop) (R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] [∀ d, DecidablePred (R d)]
    (hsplit : ∀ d e, g d ≠ 0 → f e ≠ 0 → P (d * e) → Q d ∨ R d e) (u : ℝ) :
    SdivP (g * f) P u ≤
      (∑ d ∈ (Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊).filter Q, g d / d * Sdiv f (u - Real.log d))
      + ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊, g d / d * SdivP f (R d) (u - Real.log d)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.SdivP_nonneg
statement:
lemma SdivP_nonneg {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ SdivP f P u

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.SdivP_or_le

    [DecidablePred Q] (u : ℝ) : SdivP f (fun n => P n ∨ Q n) u ≤ SdivP f P u + SdivP f Q u

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.mertens_monomial
statement:
theorem mertens_monomial (a : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    |(∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊, Λ n / n * Real.log n ^ a) - u ^ (a + 1) / (a + 1)|
      ≤ 2 * KM * (1 + u) ^ a

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.prime_logpow_sum
statement:
theorem prime_logpow_sum (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u →
    |(∑ p ∈ (Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log p ^ b / p) - u ^ b / b|
      ≤ C * (1 + u) ^ (b - 1)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.sum_not_prime_lam_logpow_div_le
statement:
lemma sum_not_prime_lam_logpow_div_le (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    ∑ n ∈ (Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp u⌋₊).filter (fun n => ¬ n.Prime), Λ n / n * Real.log n ^ (b - 1)
      ≤ u ^ (b - 2) * (2 * Cdef)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.sum_prime_logpow_eq
statement:
lemma sum_prime_logpow_eq (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (X : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ (Ioc 0 X).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log p ^ b / p
      = (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 X, Λ n / n * Real.log n ^ (b - 1))
        - ∑ n ∈ (Ioc 0 X).filter (fun n => ¬ n.Prime), Λ n / n * Real.log n ^ (b - 1)

statement:
theorem eGen_H1 (hre : ∀ T, (Lb T).re = l T / 2) {T : ℝ} (hT : T0re ≤ T) (r : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx2 : 2 ≤ x) (hxl : x ≤ Real.exp (l T)) :
    ∑ N ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ‖eGen Lb T r N‖ / Real.sqrt N ≤ CF * (4 / l T) ^ r * Real.sqrt x * l T

statement:
theorem eGen_H2 (hre : ∀ T, (Lb T).re = l T / 2) {T : ℝ} (hT : T0re ≤ T) (r : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx2 : 2 ≤ x) (hxl : x ≤ Real.exp (l T)) :

statement:
theorem eGen_H3 (hre : ∀ T, (Lb T).re = l T / 2) {T : ℝ} (hT : T0re ≤ T) (r : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx2 : 2 ≤ x) (hxl : x ≤ Real.exp (l T)) :
    ∑ N ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ‖eGen Lb T r N‖ ^ 2 / N ≤ CF * (4 / l T) ^ (2 * r) * l T ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log x)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.eGen_block_eq
statement:
lemma eGen_block_eq (T δ : ℝ) (N n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Ω N), ((Lb T)⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) * ((lamLogConv j N : ℝ) : ℂ)
        * ((((n + j).choose j : ℕ) : ℂ) * (-(δ : ℂ) / Lb T) ^ n)
      = eGen Lb T n N * (δ : ℂ) ^ n

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.eGen_expand
statement:
theorem eGen_expand (hre : ∀ T, (Lb T).re = l T / 2) {T : ℝ} (hl : 2 ≤ l T) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (1 / 2)) (N : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun r : ℕ => eGen Lb T (r + 1) N * (δ : ℂ) ^ (r + 1))
      (xiCoeff (Lb T + δ) N - xiCoeff (Lb T) N)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Fmaj_tail_small
statement:
theorem Fmaj_tail_small : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ (x u : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ u → x * u ≤ 4 →
    32 * Real.exp 1 * KM * x ≤ 1 → ∀ X : ℕ,
      (∑ i ∈ (Finset.range X).filter (fun i => K ≤ i),
        2 ^ (i + 1) * x ^ (2 * (i + 1)) * u ^ (i + 1) * Sdiv (Λ ^ (i + 1)) u) ≤ ε

statement: theorem Pc_neg_vonMangoldt (X τ : ℝ) : Pc X (fun N => -((Λ N : ℝ) : ℂ)) τ = PX X τ

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.c_mul_k_add_conj_mul_k_neg
statement:
theorem c_mul_k_add_conj_mul_k_neg {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : Continuous k) (hki : Integrable k)
    (hFk : Integrable (𝓕 k)) (c : ℂ) (y : ℝ) :
    c * k y + conj c * k (-y)
      = (1 / π : ℂ) * ∫ τ : ℝ, paperFT k τ * ((c.re * Real.cos (τ * y) + c.im * Real.sin (τ * y) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.complex_summand_eq_zero
statement:
theorem complex_summand_eq_zero {k : ℝ → ℂ} {L : ℝ} (hks : tsupport k ⊆ Icc (-L) L) (c : ℕ → ℂ)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : N ∉ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp L⌋₊) :
    (c N * k (Real.log N) + conj (c N) * k (-Real.log N)) / ((Real.sqrt N : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0

theorem integrable_paperFT_mul_Pc {k : ℝ → ℂ} (L : ℝ) (hFk : Integrable (𝓕 k)) (c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun τ : ℝ => paperFT k τ * ((Pc (Real.exp L) c τ : ℝ) : ℂ))

statement:
theorem integrable_paperFT_mul_sin {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hFk : Integrable (𝓕 k)) (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun r : ℝ => paperFT k r * (Real.sin (r * y) : ℂ))

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.integrable_paperFT_mul_trig
statement:
theorem integrable_paperFT_mul_trig {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hFk : Integrable (𝓕 k)) (c : ℂ) (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun r : ℝ => paperFT k r * ((c.re * Real.cos (r * y) + c.im * Real.sin (r * y) : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.mul_cexp_add_conj_mul_cexp
statement:
theorem mul_cexp_add_conj_mul_cexp (c : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) :
    c * cexp (-I * θ) + conj c * cexp (I * θ) = 2 * ((c.re * Real.cos θ + c.im * Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.nuc_xiCoeff_eq'
statement:
theorem nuc_xiCoeff_eq' (X : ℝ) (Λs : ℂ) (τ : ℝ) :
    nuc X (xiCoeff Λs) τ = nuX X τ + Pc X (fun N => xiCoeff Λs N + ((Λ N : ℝ) : ℂ)) τ

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.paperFT_mul_Pc_eq
statement:
theorem paperFT_mul_Pc_eq (k : ℝ → ℂ) (L : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (fun τ : ℝ => paperFT k τ * ((Pc (Real.exp L) c τ : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = fun τ : ℝ => ∑ N ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp L⌋₊,
          ((1 / π : ℂ) / ((Real.sqrt N : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            (paperFT k τ * (((c N).re * Real.cos (τ * Real.log N) + (c N).im * Real.sin (τ * Real.log N) : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.prime_term_complex
statement:
theorem prime_term_complex {k : ℝ → ℂ} {L : ℝ} (hk : Continuous k) (hks : tsupport k ⊆ Icc (-L) L)
    (hFk : Integrable (𝓕 k)) (c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑' N : ℕ, (c N * k (Real.log N) + conj (c N) * k (-Real.log N)) / ((Real.sqrt N : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = ∫ τ : ℝ, paperFT k τ * ((Pc (Real.exp L) c τ : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.abel_sum_density
statement:
theorem abel_sum_density {c : ℕ → ℝ} (hc0 : c 0 = 0) {D : ℝ → ℝ} (hD : Continuous D)
    {lT L η : ℝ} (hl : 0 < lT) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hS : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → t ≤ Real.exp L →
      |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, c k) - lT ^ 2 * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(Real.log t / lT), D s| ≤ η)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hgd : Differentiable ℝ g) (hg'c : Continuous (deriv g))
    (hg'le : ∀ y : ℝ, |deriv g y| ≤ 2) (hgsupp : ∀ y : ℝ, L ≤ y → g y = 0) :
    |(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊Real.exp L⌋₊, c n * g (Real.log n))
        - lT * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..L, (D (y / lT) * g y)| ≤ 2 * η * L

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.MV_four
statement:
lemma MV_four {C : ℝ} (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (X cc : ℝ) (w φ : ℕ → ℝ)
    {M : ℕ → ℝ} {W : ℝ} (hW : 0 ≤ W) (hM : ∀ n ∈ primeRange X, |M n| ≤ W) :
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        w n * M n * w m * Real.sin (cc * (Real.log n - Real.log m) - (φ n - φ m))
          / (Real.log n - Real.log m))| ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * n ∧
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        w n * M n * w m * Real.cos (cc * (Real.log n - Real.log m) - (φ n - φ m))
          / (Real.log n - Real.log m))| ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * n ∧
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        w n * (w m * M m) * Real.sin (cc * (Real.log n - Real.log m) - (φ n - φ m))
          / (Real.log n - Real.log m))| ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * n ∧
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X, (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else
        w n * (w m * M m) * Real.cos (cc * (Real.log n - Real.log m) - (φ n - φ m))
          / (Real.log n - Real.log m))| ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * n

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.MV_size_le_w
statement:
lemma MV_size_le_w {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (X : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) {M : ℕ → ℝ} {W : ℝ} (hW : 0 ≤ W)
    (hM : ∀ n ∈ primeRange X, |M n| ≤ W) :
    C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (w n * M n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
        * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
      ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * n ∧
    C * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * (2 * n))
        * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, (w n * M n) ^ 2 * (2 * n))
      ≤ 2 * C * W * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * n

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Mform_Pc_Pc
statement:
lemma Mform_Pc_Pc {Φ : ℝ → ℝ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (X : ℝ) :
    Mform Φ T (Pc X c) (Pc X c)
      = (1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) *
        ((∑ n ∈ primeRange X, wcoef c n ^ 2 * Aminus Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log n))
          + (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
              (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else wcoef c n * wcoef c m
                * AminusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (c n).arg (c m).arg))
          + ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
              wcoef c n * wcoef c m
                * AplusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (c n).arg (c m).arg)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Mform_cosPolyPh
statement:
lemma Mform_cosPolyPh (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (X : ℝ) (w φ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Mform Φ T (cosPolyPh X w φ) (cosPolyPh X w φ)
      = (1 / 2) *
        ((∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * Aminus Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log n))
          + (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
              (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else w n * w m
                * AminusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (φ n) (φ m)))
          + ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
              w n * w m * AplusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (φ n) (φ m))

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.O1_bound_w
statement:
theorem O1_bound_w {C : ℝ} (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (hΦ2 : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2) (X : ℝ) (w φ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
        (if n = m then (0:ℝ) else w n * w m
          * AminusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (φ n) (φ m))|
      ≤ 16 * C * (∫ x, Φ x ^ 2) * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * n

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.O2_estimate_w
statement:
lemma O2_estimate_w (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (hΦ2 : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2) (X T : ℝ)
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ w n) (hw1 : w 1 = 0) (φ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |∑ n ∈ primeRange X, ∑ m ∈ primeRange X,
        w n * w m * AplusPh Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log m) (φ n) (φ m)|
      ≤ (∫ x, Φ x ^ 2) / Real.log 2 * (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n) ^ 2

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.Pc_eq_sum
statement:
lemma Pc_eq_sum (c : ℕ → ℂ) (X τ : ℝ) :
    Pc X c τ = (1 / π) * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, wcoef c n * Real.cos (τ * Real.log n - (c n).arg)

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.diag_estimate_w
statement:
lemma diag_estimate_w (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hΦ : Continuous Φ) (hΦ2 : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2)
    (hΦabs : Integrable fun x => Φ x ^ 2 * |x|) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hFT : ∀ y, ∫ x, Φ x ^ 2 * Real.cos (x * y) = 2 * π * g y) (X : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |(1 / 2) * (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * Aminus Φ T (Real.log n) (Real.log n))
        - π * T * ∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2 * g (Real.log n)|
      ≤ (1 / 2) * (∑ n ∈ primeRange X, w n ^ 2) * ∫ x, Φ x ^ 2 * |x|

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.prop_PP_c
statement:
theorem prop_PP_c (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hF : LocalHypsCore cϱ p F)
    (hT : 1 ≤ p.T) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (hc1 : c 1 = 0) :
    |Mform F.Phi p.T (Pc p.X c) (Pc p.X c)
        - p.T / π * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ ^ 2 / n * F.g (Real.log n)|
      ≤ (1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) * (8 + 8 * cϱ) * p.L * (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ ^ 2 / n)
        + (1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) * (32 * π) * C * p.L * (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ ^ 2)
        + (1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) * (2 * π / Real.log 2) * p.L
            * (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ / Real.sqrt n) ^ 2

name: Zeta23.XiPrime.prop_PP_c'
statement:
theorem prop_PP_c' (hMV : Zeta23.MVHilbert C) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hF : LocalHypsCore cϱ p F)
    (hT : 1 ≤ p.T) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (hc1 : c 1 = 0) :
    |Mform F.Phi p.T (Pc p.X c) (Pc p.X c)
        - p.T / π * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ ^ 2 / n * F.g (Real.log n)|
      ≤ KPP C cϱ * p.L *
        ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ ^ 2 / n)
          + (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ ^ 2)
          + (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊p.X⌋₊, ‖c n‖ / Real.sqrt n) ^ 2)

    (hD : frobSq D ≤ εD ^ 2 * N) (hE : frobSq E ≤ εE ^ 2 * N) :
    frobSq G ≤ (1 + (εD + εE)) * frobSq M + ((εD + εE) + (εD + εE) ^ 2) * N
